question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    o.region,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.region ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
)
SELECT region AS 大区, sku_name AS 单品, 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    bs.brand
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_net_amount, 0) > 0.10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
WITH avg_net AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_net) AS avg_total
    FROM (
        SELECT s.outlet_id, SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_net
        FROM fact_sales s
        JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
        WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
        GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    ) t
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_net)
) o

question: 每个品类销量最高的三个单品
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
)
SELECT category, sku_name, 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY category, 销量 DESC

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT
    a.category
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b ON a.category = b.category AND a.year_month = '2026-08' AND b.year_month = '2026-07'
WHERE a.total_qty > b.total_qty

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region AS 大区,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(净销额) AS 总净销额
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    rs.大区,
    rs.净销额,

    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (s.outlet_id, s.sku_id)) AS sold_combo_cnt
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE o.region = '华东'
      AND d.year_month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT listed_outlet_cnt FROM listed_outlets)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT total_outlets FROM outlet_base), 0) AS 铺市率,
    (SELECT sold_combo_cnt FROM sold_combos)::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT combo_cnt FROM listed_combos), 0) AS 动销率

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS sales_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
    mi.total_qty_on_hand / NULLIF(ms.total_qty / NULLIF(ms.sales_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM monthly_inventory mi
JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON mi.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS 大区,
    (COALESCE(c.current_net_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.previous_net_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(p.previous_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_period c
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_month AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS 单店产出
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_month AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS 单店产出
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(cm.channel, lym.channel) AS 渠道,
    lym.单店产出 AS 去年同期单店产出,
    cm.单店产出 AS 本期单店产出,
    (cm.单店产出 - lym.单店产出) / NULLIF(lym.单店产出, 0) AS 单店产出变化率
FROM current_month cm
FULL OUTER JOIN last_year_month lym ON cm.channel = lym.channel
ORDER BY 渠道

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.year_month IN ('2026-01','2026-02','2026-03','2026-04','2026-05','2026-06')
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-01','2026-02','2026-03','2026-04','2026-05','2026-06')
  GROUP BY 1
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.year_month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09','2025-10','2025-11','2025-12')
  GROUP BY 1
),
c2 AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09','2025-10','2025-11','2025-12')
  GROUP BY 1
),
h1 AS (
  SELECT SUM(s.amt) / NULLIF(SUM(c.cost), 0) AS ratio
  FROM s JOIN c USING (year_month)
),
h2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(s2.amt) / NULLIF(SUM(c2.cost), 0) AS ratio
  FROM s2 JOIN c2 USING (year_month)
)
SELECT (h1.ratio - h2.ratio) AS 费效比差值
FROM h1, h2
